reason: no_reward: Hyperliquid Earn is HyperCore-native lending ($1.48B TVL). On HyperEVM the protocol is only two read precompiles (0x...0812 reserve state, 0x...080c token info; eth_getCode 0x, eth_call with raw uint64 answers) plus the generic CoreWriter user-action bridge 0x3333..3333 (only function sendRawAction(bytes), lending = Supply/Withdraw). No EVM function anyone can call pays the caller: interest accrues passively (hourly index) to suppliers and liquidations are executed by HyperCore itself, not by callable keeper functions.
